title: Beijing railway station
exportLabel: Molen original complete Beijing station passenger building and open canopy source
visualBrief: Complete permanent Beijing railway station passenger ensemble: monumental north facade, both square clock towers with three-tier glazed Chinese roofs and finials, deep central glazed bays and rounded columns, full lateral wings and corner roof pavilions, two genuine courtyard voids, all mapped canopy bounds represented by open platform-roof wings, and the elevated connector with stairs. Preserve the native forecourt, independent service buildings, streets, rails and urban context. Exterior only; no copied signs, lettering, branding, figurative ornament, people, trains or navigable interior.

references.observed: Actually inspected ordinary 2021 north-front photograph. Warm pale stone monumental facade; two central square clock towers with black clock faces, three-tier orange/gold Chinese hip roofs and finials; larger recessed glazed central bays with heavy rounded columns, curved upper cornice and green/gold eaves. Long low wings have large recessed vertical glazing with curved tops, small upper windows and ornamental eaves; small corner roof pavilions sit at the far ends. Temporary red forecourt shelters, flags, signs, lettering, people and branding remain separate. Exact hidden rear openings and roof inventory are unverified.
Inspected train-approach photograph. It shows an independent urban rail viaduct and surrounding skyline, not the station platform canopy. Do not use it as canopy-shape evidence.

Actually inspected ordinary published2025 platform photograph. Open longitudinal rail/sky slots separate long shallow canopy wings. The canopy underside is ivory with gold-toned edge/ceiling bands, slender grey columns and branching steel support arms; transverse trusses and an elevated connector with stairs are visible. The picture shows only a selected platform section, not a complete module inventory. Use current PMTiles for whole bounds; preserve open spaces rather than filling a ground-to-roof station cuboid. Do not copy lettering, medallions, LED notices, people or trains.
